llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent for A/B test analysis. Notes to consider before installing: (1) Source/homepage is unknown—if you need assurance about implementation or maintenance, prefer skills with an auditable codebase or a known author. (2) The manifest shows a minor version mismatch (registry metadata version 1.0.46 vs skill.json 1.0.0) — likely benign but indicates sloppy packaging. (3) The skill expects you to provide CSV test data (e.g., test_data.csv); avoid uploading sensitive or production-identifying data unless you trust the environment. (4) Because there is no bundled code, the example CLI commands (openclaw run ab-test-analyzer ...) may depend on platform tooling or an external implementation; installing this skill alone does not add binaries or network endpoints. If you require stronger assurance, request the skill's implementation or prefer a skill with source code you can review.
